anna_support: Hey team — escalating a VAT reverse-charge issue from customer Nordic Apps Oy. They submitted a PO requiring net invoices but their invoice 2026-INV-4371 shows 24% VAT applied. Customer VAT ID: FI12345678. They say VIES validated their ID. I attached the billing system log and the customer's scanned resale cert: https://files.redwood.internal/support/attachments/2026-INV-4371-resale-cert.pdf

mike_billing: Thanks. Can you paste the invoice & account IDs and the billing log lines? Did the auto-exempt rules trigger?

anna_support: Invoice: 2026-INV-4371, Account: acct_00987_nordic. Billing log snippet: `tax_calc: invoice=2026-INV-4371 applied_rate=0.24 rule=default_vat; tax_validator: vies_status=VALID vies_name="NORDICAPPS OY" local_name="Nordic Apps Oy" name_match=false`

raj_engineer: Hmm. Looks like name_match=false. We rely on exact-normalized name compare for automatic reverse-charge. Can you paste the full tax validator webhook payload? Might be normalization / spacing issue.

anna_support: Pasted webhook payload (sanitized):
```
{
  "vat_id": "FI12345678",
  "status": "VALID",
  "name": "NORDICAPPS OY",
  "request_name": "Nordic Apps Oy",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-17T09:14:02Z"
}
```
Billing service log shows: `normalize_name(request_name) -> NORDICAPPSOY, normalize_name(vies_name) -> NORDICAPPS OY` (note the extra space). Our current normalizer removes spaces, which produced `NORDICAPPSOY` vs `NORDICAPPS OY` and then strict compare fails.

vat-bot: Automated VAT check: VIES returned VALID for FI12345678, name returned "NORDICAPPS OY". Our matching routine: exact(normalize(vies_name)) == exact(normalize(request_name)). Suggest switching to fuzzy match with Levenshtein distance <= 2 for production to tolerate OCR/formatting differences.

mike_billing: If it's a normalization bug we should fix ingestion, but customer needs correct invoice asap. Finance, can we do a manual override / re-issue net invoice if customer provides resale cert? What evidence do you need?

olga_finance: We can issue a credit note and reissue a net invoice if we have accepted evidence. For EU reverse-charge we need either a validated VIES match OR a signed resale certificate + PO showing net-payable terms. OCR alone isn't sufficient unless confidence > 90%. Please attach the original PDF and a short chain-of-evidence note. Also provide the customer's PO number.

anna_support: Uploaded the PDF and OCR output: https://files.redwood.internal/support/attachments/2026-INV-4371-resale-cert.pdf (OCR confidence: 72%). PO#: PO-55219. Customer also sent an email from finance@nordicapps.fi confirming they are VAT-registered.

raj_engineer: For immediate unblock we can run a targeted reprocess which bypasses strict name equality and honors VIES status + supplied resale cert. Command I will run in staging first:
```
curl -X POST https://billing.redwood.internal/admin/recompute-tax \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED]" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"invoice_id":"2026-INV-4371","force_vat_exempt":true,"evidence":{"resale_cert_url":"https://files.redwood.internal/support/attachments/2026-INV-4371-resale-cert.pdf","ocr_confidence":"72","po":"PO-55219"}}'
```
I'll only do this after finance approves. We also need an audit entry in the invoice history. I'll add a feature ticket to adjust normalization and switch to fuzzy comparison.

olga_finance: Approve manual override contingent on attaching the resale cert in our records and a short signed confirmation from our side. Please create a Finance approval note in the invoice and add `finance_approved:olga_finance` before running. Then we will issue a credit note and reissue net invoice.

mike_billing: I'll queue the credit note once olga confirms. Also, add a temporary rule to allow exceptions for specific acct_ IDs while eng fixes the normalizer.

anna_support: Noted. I've asked the customer for the signed confirmation and posted the email thread here: https://files.redwood.internal/support/attachments/nordicapps-email-thread.eml. Marking as #priority-high — customer says PO payment is on hold until invoice reflects net amount.

raj_engineer: ETA: I'll run staging test in ~45m, then schedule the admin reprocess in non-peak hours if finance approves. I'll also open PR for fuzzy-name matching and add unit tests for the common spacing/OCR cases.

mike_billing: Sounds good. Please ping when staging test passes so we can plan the reissue. :white_check_mark:

anna_support: Thanks all. Will update customer with estimated timeline and let finance know when documents are in place.

vat-bot: NOTE: created ticket TAX-9483 for name-normalization fuzziness; assigned to raj_engineer.
